{{Short description|Swedish mathematician, professor, and author (1925–2012)}}
'''Bengt Beckman''' (30 September 1925 – 13 March 2012) was a Swedish mathematician, university professor and bestselling author.

He worked as a research engineer at Tandem laboratory in [[Uppsala]], Sweden.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://katalog.uu.se/profile/?id=XX2103|title=Bengt Beckman - Uppsala University, Sweden|work=uu.se|accessdate=30 March 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170330083226/http://katalog.uu.se/profile/?id=XX2103|archive-date=30 March 2017|url-status=dead}}</ref> As an author, he wrote about [[cryptography]] in Sweden, particularly about [[Arne Beurling]].

== Publications ==

Some of his books and papers are:<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.goodreads.com/author/show/116240.Bengt_Beckman|title=Bengt Beckman|work=goodreads.com|accessdate=30 March 2017}}</ref>

* ''Swedish cryptography achievements'', [[Bonniers]], 1996, {{ISBN|91-0-056229-7}}
* ''The world's first encryption machine - Gripenstiernas cipher-Machine 1786'', the National Defense Radio Establishment, [[Bromma]], 1999
* ''Thus the Z machine was broken - reconstruction of the Lorenz SZ40 / 42'', the National Defense Radio Establishment, Bromma, 1999
* ''Swedish Signal Intelligence: 1900-1945'', [[Frank Cass Publishers]], 2002, {{ISBN|0-7146-5211-3}}
* ''In front of your eyes - drawings and comments'', [[Johanneshov]], 2010
